extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policymakers, and general readers seeking country reference data
extracted.subtask_description: Structured country reference/profile entries (CIA World Factbook style) that summarize a country's geography, people, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, and transnational issues using standardized fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation from the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Chief of mission, embassy/consulate locations, mailing address, telephone, FAX (e.g., 'chief of mission: Ambassador J. Thomas SCHIEFFER; embassy: Moonah Place, Yarralumla, Canberra... consulate(s) general: Melbourne, Perth, Sydney').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to list the U.S. diplomatic presence in the country; includes contact details and consular posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation in the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Host-country chief of mission to the United States, chancery/embassy address and consulates, telephone and FAX (e.g., 'chief of mission: Ambassador Eva NOWOTNY; chancery: 3524 International Court NW, Washington, DC 20008-3035').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the host country's diplomatic representation in the U.S.; includes contact details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Text description of the national flag symbolism and appearance (e.g., 'blue with the flag of the UK in the upper hoist-side quadrant and a large seven-pointed star... the Southern Cross constellation in white...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise verbal description of flag elements and symbolic meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative summary of the national economy, key strengths/weaknesses, trends, and policy concerns (e.g., Australia's overview: 'enviable Western-style capitalist economy... emphasis on reforms, low inflation, and growing ties with China... concerns: domestic housing bubble').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides context and qualitative assessment of major economic drivers and challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP (purchasing power parity) and GDP - real growth rate and per capita
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantitative GDP indicators including purchasing power parity total, real growth rate, and per capita PPP (e.g., 'purchasing power parity - $571.4 billion (2003 est.)'; 'GDP - real growth rate: 3% (2003 est.)'; 'GDP - per capita: $29,000 (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard macroeconomic size and growth metrics with year and estimate notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent shares of GDP by major sectors (agriculture, industry, services) (e.g., 'agriculture: 3.5%; industry: 26.3%; services: 70.2% (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows sectoral structure of the economy; year-tagged estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gross fixed investment as a percent of GDP (e.g., '24.8% of GDP (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of overall investment activity in the economy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Poverty / population below poverty line
rubrics_metrics.description: Share or notation regarding population below national poverty line (e.g., 'Population below poverty line: NA' or percentage if available).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports poverty incidence where available; may be 'NA' if not provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Household income or consumption by percentage share and Gini index
rubrics_metrics.description: Distributional measures such as income share by decile and Gini index (e.g., 'lowest 10%: 2%; highest 10%: 25.4% (1994)'; 'Distribution of family income - Gini index: 35.2 (1994)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides measures of income inequality and distribution; includes year of data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation rate (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual consumer price inflation estimate and year (e.g., '2.8% (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard consumer price index inflation figure with year tag.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force and labor force - by occupation
rubrics_metrics.description: Size of labor force and occupational distribution (e.g., 'Labor force: 10.19 million (37256)'; 'by occupation: agriculture 5%, industry 22%, services 73% (1997 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports labor force totals and percent breakdown by sector; includes year and occasionally footnotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unemployment rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Unemployment percentage and year (e.g., '6% (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard unemployment metric with year estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: revenues and expenditures
rubrics_metrics.description: Government budget totals for revenues and expenditures and notes on capital expenditures (e.g., 'revenues: $185 billion; expenditures: $181 billion... (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows fiscal scale; often year-tagged and may lack capital expenditure detail (NA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Public debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Public debt as percent of GDP with year (e.g., '18.2% of GDP (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard government debt burden indicator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture - products
rubrics_metrics.description: List of principal agricultural products (e.g., 'wheat, barley, sugarcane, fruits; cattle, sheep, poultry').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates major crops and livestock outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industries
rubrics_metrics.description: Major industrial sectors and manufacturing strengths (e.g., 'mining, industrial and transportation equipment, food processing, chemicals, steel').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes prominent industries and economic specializations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial production growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual percent growth of industrial production (e.g., '-0.1% (2003 est.)' or '1.9% (2003 est.)' for other country entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of short-term industrial sector performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity (production, consumption, exports, imports)
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity production, consumption and cross-border flows, with year tags (e.g., 'production: 198.2 billion kWh (2001)'; 'consumption: 184.4 billion kWh (2001)'; 'exports: 0 kWh (2001)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Energy sector metrics for electricity including year and units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil statistics (production, consumption, exports, imports, proved reserves)
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil production and consumption per day, export/import flows, and proved reserves with year (e.g., 'production: 731,000 bbl/day (2001 est.)'; 'proved reserves: 3.664 billion bbl (1 January 2002)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key petroleum sector indicators with dates and units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas statistics (production, consumption, exports, imports, proved reserves)
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural gas production/consumption/exports/imports and proved reserves with units and year (e.g., 'production: 33.08 billion cu m (2001 est.)'; 'proved reserves: 2.407 trillion cu m (1 January 2002)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard natural gas sector metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current account balance / Trade (exports, imports, commodities and partners)
rubrics_metrics.description: Current account balance and trade totals with commodity lists and top trading partners (e.g., 'Current account balance: $-30.14 billion (2003)'; 'Exports: $68.67 billion (2003 est.)'; 'Exports - commodities: coal, gold, meat...'; 'Exports - partners: Japan 18.1%, US 8.7%...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows external sector performance and major trading partners/commodities; includes year estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves of foreign exchange & gold; Debt - external; Economic aid - donor
rubrics_metrics.description: Foreign exchange and gold reserves, external debt totals, and official development assistance figures (e.g., 'Reserves...: $33.26 billion (2003)'; 'Debt - external: $233.5 billion (2003 est.)'; 'Economic aid - donor: ODA, $894 million (FY99/00)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External balance sheet and aid indicators with dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency, currency code, exchange rates, fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: National currency name and code, historical exchange rates to USD by year, and fiscal year definition (e.g., 'Australian dollar (AUD)'; 'Australian dollars per US dollar - 1.5419 (2003), 1.8406 (2002)...'; 'Fiscal year: 1 July - 30 June').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary identifiers and typical exchange rate history data; fiscal year timeframe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications (telephones, mobile cellular, telephone system, radio/TV/internet stats)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of main telephone lines and mobile cellular subscriptions, description of telephone system, radio and television station counts, and Internet hosts/ISPs/users (e.g., 'Telephones - main lines in use: 10.815 million (2003)'; 'mobile cellular: 14.347 million (2003)'; 'Telephone system: general assessment: excellent domestic and international service'; 'Internet hosts: 2,847,763 (2003)'; 'Internet users: 9.472 million (2002)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines infrastructure quantities and qualitative assessment of communications networks; year-tagged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation (railways, highways, waterways, pipelines, ports and harbors, merchant marine, airports)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistics and lists for transport infrastructure: railway lengths and gauges, highway totals (paved/unpaved), waterways length, pipeline lengths, ports and harbors, merchant fleet stats, and airports (including counts by runway type) (e.g., 'Railways: total: 44,015 km (5,290 km electrified)'; 'Highways: total: 811,603 km'; 'Airports: 444 (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive transport infrastructure indicators and facility lists with units and years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military (branches, manpower, expenditures)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of military branches, manpower eligibility/availability figures, and military expenditures both in dollars and percent of GDP (e.g., 'Military branches: Australian Army, Royal Australian Navy, Royal Australian Air Force...'; 'Military expenditures - dollar figure: $14,120.1 million (2003)'; 'percent of GDP: 2.8% (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes organization and resource commitment to defense; includes manpower stats and expenditure measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues (disputes, illicit drugs)
rubrics_metrics.description: International disputes and transnational criminal or production issues (e.g., 'the 1999 maritime delimitation established partial maritime boundaries with East Timor...'; 'Illicit drugs: Tasmania is one of the world's major suppliers of licit opiate products...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights cross-border disputes and transnational challenges affecting the country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography (location, coordinates, area, climate, terrain, elevation extremes, natural resources, land use, irrigated land, natural hazards, environment issues, international agreements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic setting and physical-environmental details including map references, area (total/water/land), climate summary, terrain description, low/high elevation points, natural resources list, land use percentages, irrigated land area, natural hazards, current environmental issues, and international environmental agreements (e.g., Austria: 'Location: Central Europe... Area: total: 83,870 sq km... Climate: temperate; continental, cloudy... Natural resources: oil, coal, lignite, timber... Environment - current issues: some forest degradation caused by air and soil pollution...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive geographic and environmental profile with multiple subfields; includes treaty participation notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: People / Demographics (population, age structure, median age, population growth, birth/death rates, migration, sex ratio, infant mortality, life expectancy, fertility, HIV/AIDS, nationality, ethnic groups, religions, languages, literacy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Demographic and social statistics: total population with year, age distribution percentages, median age, growth rate, birth and death rates, net migration rate, sex ratios by age groups, infant mortality rates, life expectancy at birth, total fertility rate, HIV/AIDS prevalence and counts, nationality noun/adjective, ethnic composition, religious breakdown, languages (official and regional), and literacy rates (e.g., 'Population: 8,174,762 (July 2004 est.)'; 'Life expectancy at birth: total population: 78.87 years').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidates population and social health/demographic indicators with year references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government (country name, government type, capital, administrative divisions, independence, national holiday, constitution, legal system, suffrage, executive/legislative/judicial branches, political parties and leaders, pressure groups, international organization participation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Civic and political structure information including formal country names, government type, capital, list of administrative units, dates of independence, national holidays, constitution information, legal system description, voting age and suffrage notes, summaries of executive/legislative/judicial branches with leaders and election notes, lists of political parties and leaders, key pressure groups, and international organization memberships (e.g., 'Government type: federal republic'; 'Capital: Vienna'; 'Legislative branch: bicameral Federal Assembly...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides institutional and political organization with leadership names and recent election results where available.
